source: Measured from CoolClimate household calculator API (coolclimate.berkeley.edu, household-staging) by finite differences, 2026-08-11. Location 94110, defaults baseline; all factors verified linear in their input.
units: kg CO2e; inputs are annual miles (or flight counts)
notes: vehicle fuel burn = miles / mpg * fuel_per_gallon (direct + upstream); manufacturing is per-mile and applies to all fuel types (an extra vehicle with 0 miles adds nothing)
fuel=electric zeroes fuel emissions entirely in their model - no electricity is added to the housing section either (quirk, duplicated as-is)
bus 1.3 g/mile is CoolClimate's own staging-model output and is ~100x below their take-action constant (107 g/mi) - almost certainly their units bug, duplicated as-is and flagged in the UI
air flight counts are round trips: short/medium/long/extended = 152/408/814/1376 kg each incl. upstream; per-mile mode = 0.4464 kg/mile
